messages:
Rae (People Ops): FYI rolling out two quick clarifications today re: urgent travel + PTO accounting after last week's questions. 1) If you travel for urgent customer-facing work and it's classified as an 'operational emergency', you can request an expedited travel exception and choose whether time away is charged to PTO or logged as 'Operational Leave' (not deducted from PTO) for up to 3 days. 2) For health-related follow-up appointments after a business trip (same country), employees can use a 4-hour 'medical buffer' without filing PTO if they notify their manager within 48h. Details + form: https://redwood.company/hr/urgent-travel-clarify :memo:
Sam (Support): nice. how do we tag "operational emergency" on the form?
Rae (People Ops): there's a checkbox and a short required field for incident link or customer contact. Security/Legal auto-notified if cross-border.
Ida (Recruiting): does this apply to candidates or offer travel?
Rae (People Ops): No, candidates/offers handled separately. This policy is for employees only. Recruiter exceptions route via Talent Ops.
Tom (Finance): ops note: if someone selects Operational Leave, payroll will not deduct PTO; we still report it on payslips as "Operational Leave" for transparency. Cross-border tax rules may vary.
Ops Bot: Reminder: submit expedited travel exception via https://redwood.company/forms/expedite. Missing incident link will mark request as manual review.
Sam (Support): retroactive cases? someone flew last week and forgot to file.
Rae (People Ops): managers can retro-approve within 10 days. After that People Ops intervention required. If urgent, DM me and include the flight/incident link.
Ida (Recruiting): for the medical buffer, is docs required?
Rae (People Ops): no docs for the 4-hour buffer. If it becomes more than 4 hours or recurs, we may ask for standard medical verification.
Tom (Finance): we'll add a line in next payroll export so managers can reconcile Operational Leave vs PTO.
Rae (People Ops): thanks all. We'll monitor usage for 30 days and adjust. Drop issues in #people-ops or ping me directly. :wave:
